title: FDA Issues Complete Response Letter to Ivonescimab Plus Chemotherapy in EGFR-Mutated NSCLC
detail: Around its November 14, 2026 PDUFA date, the FDA declined to approve Summit's PD-1/VEGF bispecific ivonescimab with platinum chemotherapy for EGFR-mutated NSCLC after a third-generation EGFR TKI, saying the HARMONi progression-free survival gain without a statistically significant overall survival benefit did not support a favorable benefit-risk profile. Reported Nov 15-16.

media.caption: FDA issues CRL to ivonescimab plus chemotherapy
